mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, NVL(MIN(I.QUANTITY), 0) AS minQuantity, NVL(MAX(I.QUANTITY), 0) AS maxQuantity FROM PRODUCTS P, INVENTORIES I WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID(+) GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID
